info.name: LedgerOne - Accounting (Financial Reports)
info.description:
Financial Reporting engine API collection (Trial Balance Ch.24, Balance Sheet Ch.26, Profit & Loss Ch.25, Cash Flow Ch.27 simplified indirect method, Closing-Readiness Ch.32). Every report is read-only — no create/update/delete/post/approve/reverse endpoint exists anywhere in this collection; all reports are derived over the existing Ledger/Chart of Accounts data via the shared business/reports/ engine. Setup creates its own Financial Year/Fiscal Period/Account Groups/Accounts and posts four Journal Entries (capital injection $2000, sale on credit $500, rent paid in cash $300, expense on credit $150) so every report has real, cross-checkable numbers: Trial Balance totals 2950/2950; Balance Sheet Assets 2200 = Liabilities 150 + Equity 2050 (incl. Current Year Earnings 50); P&L Net Profit = 500 - 450 = 50; Cash Flow's Net Cash Flow (1700) reconciles exactly to the Cash account's own period movement. The Cash account is deliberately placed in its own 'Cash and Bank'-named Account Group, distinct from Receivables' group, since Cash Flow's simplified indirect method identifies Cash/Bank accounts by Account Group name (see get-cash-flow.service.ts) — this is what exercises that heuristic correctly.

Design note (JWT required): same convention as every other collection in this folder — every protected request carries `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`, the same long-lived dev-only token for tenantId 900001 already used by FinancialYear/FiscalPeriod/ChartOfAccounts/Currency/Tax/JournalEntries/Ledger.

Design note (repeatability): a collection-level pre-request script generates `{{frYear}}`/`{{frYearEnd}}` (base 9000, distinct from every other collection's own base/modulus sharing the same financial_years/accounts tables under the same companyUuid) once per Newman invocation.

Run order for a full pass, top to bottom: every 'Setup' request must run first, in order, to seed fixture variables; every 'Reports' and 'Errors' request depends on them (the pagination and cursor-chaining requests within 'Reports' must also run in the order shown).

exec: // Computed once per Newman invocation (not per request) — base 9000, distinct from
// (6000/6600/7200), and Ledger (8000), since all of these write into the same
// financial_years/accounts tables under the same companyUuid.
// A dedicated, freshly-generated companyUuid PER Newman invocation —
// deliberately NOT the shared {{companyUuid}} environment variable every
// other collection in this folder reuses. Trial Balance/Balance Sheet are
// cumulative-since-inception reports scoped to the WHOLE company's Chart of
// Accounts (unlike Ledger's own per-account scoping) — reusing one company
// across repeated runs would let each run's own permanently-Open Financial
// Year (this epic implements no closing mutation) leak its Revenue/Expense
// difference into every later run's Balance Sheet totals, since that stale
// year's earnings are never transferred to Retained Earnings (Ch.32, out of
// scope here). A fresh company per run keeps each run's own numbers exact
// and independently verifiable, which is what proves repeatability.
